subject: Evaluation kit transfer + MAP and close timeline
messages:
From: Priya Shah <pshah@acmeai.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>; rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T09:03:00Z
Subject: Eval kit exchange + MAP — timeline request

Hi Jordan / Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. We want to move quickly on a short evaluation ahead of our procurement window. To keep things moving we propose a mutual action plan (MAP) and hand off a small evaluation dataset and prompt pack so your team can run Redwood against our baseline tests.

A few constraints from our side before we share data:
- The dataset contains partially redacted customer interactions; we need a written agreement that Redwood will only use it for evaluation and will not index or add to training corpora.
- We require the dataset and any derived outputs to be deleted after 90 days unless otherwise agreed.
- Some records include internal identifiers; you must not attempt to re-identify or share PII.

Can you confirm you can accept these usage constraints and propose a quick MAP with milestones and a target close by end of May? Attaching a short README for the eval kit we plan to send.

Attachments: Acme_Eval_Dataset_README.txt (text)

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Product, Acme AI
pshah@acmeai.com
From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@acmeai.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T11:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Eval kit exchange + MAP — timeline request

Priya — thanks for the clear note and for sharing the README. We can absolutely proceed under the constraints you outlined. Below is a proposed MAP and a few housekeeping items to make the handoff smooth.

High-level MAP (draft):
1) Legal sign-off on eval-only usage & data handling — target: 2026-05-14 (DocuSign link to follow).
2) Secure handoff of the eval kit (S3 link + short README) — target: 2026-05-15.
3) Redwood runs baseline evaluation using your prompt pack & test cases (2 business days to run, initial metrics) — target window: 2026-05-16 to 2026-05-18.
4) Joint review call to go over results & quick optimizations — target: 2026-05-19.
5) Close target: customer PO or hosted pilot agreement signed by 2026-05-28.

Data usage constraints we accept (confirming):
- Evaluation-only: Redwood will use datasets solely for the Acme evaluation and will not retain datasets in training stores.
- Retention: Redwood will delete the dataset and any intermediate model outputs within 90 days following the end of the evaluation unless we have a written extension.
- No re-identification: Redwood agrees not to attempt re-identification of redacted records.
- Access controls: only jordan_blake and rishi_malhotra and engineering staff on the evaluation will have access; we will share access logs upon request.

I've attached a one-page MAP and a short licensing constraints doc for your legal team. If that looks good, we can send DocuSign and the S3 link for the dataset by Friday.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (pdf), eval-kit-license-constraints.docx (docx)

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@acmeai.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T08:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Eval kit exchange + MAP — timeline request

Thanks Priya — quick note from engineering ops.

Operational checklist for handoff:
- We'll provide a time-limited S3 bucket with presigned URLs (7 day expiry) and scoped IAM role for retrieval.
- We will run evaluation jobs inside a private VPC environment; logs and KV-cache artifacts will be isolated and not forwarded externally.
- Please remove any production customer identifiers we should not have; if anything requires further redaction, flag it in the README.
- We request a minimal metadata file (CSV) that maps test-case IDs to expected outcomes so our eval harness can compute pass/fail quickly.

I will kick off job templates and share the run-command doc once we have the dataset link.

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <pshah@acmeai.com>

Date: 2026-05-14T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Eval kit exchange + MAP — timeline request

Jordan / Rishi — this looks good and legal has a couple small edits to the license clause (explicit prohibition on model outputs being used for benchmarking outside this engagement). I attached the requested minimal CSV and the dataset README is already sanitized.

We are ready for DocuSign. Can you send the final MAP PDF and DocuSign link today? Also Tom from our engineering team will join the results call on 5/19.

Attachments: Acme_eval_metadata.csv (csv)

Best,
Priya

Priya — thanks, received the CSV and README. DocuSign sent (link below) with the small legal edit included (we added the explicit non-benchmarking clause). Once signed we will:

- Provision S3 package and secure access (ETA: 48 hours after signature).
- Run baseline eval and share initial metrics within 48 hours of data retrieval.
- Schedule the 5/19 review at 10am PT with Tom and our engineering team.
